coverage: CME Group Globex holiday schedules for calendar years 2013, 2014 and 2015, complete for every U.S. holiday CME published a schedule for. 33 operator documents (31 PDFs + 2 XLS) retrieved at T1 from the Internet Archive id_ raw replay of cmegroup.com/tools-information/holiday-calendar/files/*, enumerated first by CDX prefix search. 71 affected trade dates x 9 product families = 634 rows. Families: equity_index, interest_rates, fx, energy, metals, grains_oilseeds, livestock, dairy, lumber. Holidays covered each year: New Year's Day (+ New Year's Eve and the reopening day), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (+ the Friday before), Presidents' Day (+ the Friday before), Good Friday (+ the Thursday before), Memorial Day (+ the Friday before), Independence Day (+ the day before and the reopening day; 2015 observed on Friday July 3), Labor Day (+ the Friday before), Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving (+ the Wednesday before and the day after), Christmas (+ Christmas Eve and the reopening day). Juneteenth is out of range (CME first scheduled it in 2022). Every instant is recorded exactly as CME printed it: CT alone for CME/CBOT sections in 2013, CT / ET for the NYMEX-COMEX-DME section in 2013, and CT / ET / UTC for every section from January 2014 onward.
missing: globex_nikkei_225_dollar - no Nikkei-specific line exists on any CME Group holiday schedule for 2013, 2014 or 2015. 'grep -il nikkei' over all 33 extracted documents returns nothing; Nikkei 225 dollar futures are covered only by the undifferentiated 'CME & CBOT Equity Products' / 'Equity Products' heading. Channels tried: every 2013-2015 holiday PDF and XLS in the CDX enumeration, plus the 2013/2014/2015 holiday-calendar index pages. This is an absence in the operator's document, not a retrieval failure - the equity_index rows are the operator's statement for the Nikkei family.

globex_cryptocurrency, all 2013-2015 holidays - CME listed no cryptocurrency product before Bitcoin futures on 2017-12-18, so no crypto line exists to source. Nothing missing; the family simply did not exist.

Good Friday 2013, livestock/dairy/lumber early close - CME prints '1355 - Early Close for Lumber, Dairy & Livestock' with NO time zone on that line (every other time in the document is CT, and the 2014/2015 equivalents print '1355 CT / 1455 ET / 1855 UTC'). The zone is recorded as unstated rather than inferred from the later years.

2013 Columbus Day and 2013 Veterans Day - CME's PDFs say only 'Products listed on Globex are unaffected and will run on a normal schedule'; no per-family instants are printed, so the rows carry status 'normal' with that single sentence as the verbatim rather than group-level times. Same for the 2014 and 2015 Columbus Day XLS files.

Columbus Day 2014 and 2015 - CME published no PDF; only 2014-columbus-day-holiday-schedule.xls and 2015-columbus-day-holiday-schedule.xls exist in the archive (settlement-times PDFs exist but are not session language). Sourced from the XLS, read with xlrd; recorded, not missing, but the container is weaker than the PDFs.

2014 MLK schedule prints '1515 CT / 1615 ET / 2215 UTC' for the Friday Jan 17 Interest Rate & FX early close; 1515 CT is 2115 UTC. CME's UTC column is wrong on that one line. Recorded verbatim with the discrepancy flagged; the CT and ET values are corroborated by the identical 2014 Presidents' Day, Memorial Day and Labor Day lines, which print 2115/2015 UTC correctly.

Dairy, Lumber and Livestock reopening instants on the day after a full closure (e.g. 2014-12-26, 2015-01-02) are recorded as status 'modified' rather than 'late_open' for livestock and lumber, because CME prints the opening instant without labelling it early or late and those instants match the routine day-session opens the same documents print for ordinary Tuesdays. Dairy is 'late_open' because the same documents state dairy's routine open as 1700 CT on the prior evening.

Intraday phase topology - none of these documents describes what happens to a family's internal phases (e.g. the CBOT grain day-session break) on a holiday; only the scalar open/close/halt instants quoted here are sourced. Anything finer is a gap.

Open-outcry (trading floor) holiday hours - the Chicago and New York trading-floor holiday cards for 2013-2015 exist in the archive and were NOT retrieved or recorded, because this crate models Globex matching, not the floor.
holidays_grouped_note: The 'holidays' array groups families that CME prints in one section and that carry an identical line: e.g. 'interest_rates+fx' is CME's single 'Interest Rate & FX Products' section, 'energy+metals' its 'Energy, Metals & DME Products' section (2013: 'NYMEX, COMEX & DME'), and 'livestock+dairy+lumber' its 'Livestock, Dairy & Lumber Products' section (2013: 'Other CME Group Products'). Where CME prints different instants per product the families are split out individually.
